description:
Buddy Day Planner is the day planner you talk to. With this plugin, you can plan in ChatGPT and send the result to the Buddy app on your iPhone.

Ask ChatGPT to plan something: a study week, a weekend of chores, the next steps of a project. ChatGPT shows the tasks on a card first, with the day, the time, how long each one takes, and any reminder or repeat. Leave out the ones you don't want, then tap Send.

The tasks wait in Drafts in Buddy. Nothing goes on your plan until you add it there yourself.

ChatGPT can only send tasks to Buddy. It can't see, change or delete anything already in Buddy.

To connect, you need the Buddy app on iPhone, signed in, with your age set to 18 or over. In Buddy, open Account, then Tasks. Under Connected apps, tap ChatGPT, then Get a code. Type the code on the page ChatGPT opens, then tap Allow in Buddy.

defaultPrompt: Plan my Saturday chores and show them before sending to Buddy.
Break my project into steps I can finish this week and send them to Buddy.
Put these in Buddy: revise chapter 3 Monday 7pm for 45 min, past paper Wednesday 7pm for an hour.
